6.5 Electrical Characteristics
1.7V ≤ VDD ≤ 6.5V, RLRESET = 100kΩ, CLRESET = 50pF, over operating temperature range (TJ = –40°C to 125°C), unless
otherwise noted. Typical values are at TJ = 25°C(1).
